# FMC Media PC 0.3.0

- New Anime page: Top 10 trending with numbers, this season, top rated, all-time popular, coming soon and genre rows.
- One switch on the Anime page shows All, Series only or Movies only (All by default); it also filters Browse all.
- Top rated uses MyAnimeList scores when a free MyAnimeList Client ID is saved in Settings → Metadata, else AniList scores.
- Long anime descriptions show three lines with a More button, without the notes appended to them.
- Library titles imported without artwork (Simkl, Trakt, other devices) now get their poster, name and year.

Update from Settings → About → Check for updates. Activation, library and watch progress are preserved. Windows x64.
